summary.intent: Fix pre-existing linting warnings in a GitHub Actions workflow file and push the changes to remote.
summary.outcome: Fixed actionlint warnings (SC2086 unquoted variable and SC2129 separate redirects) in the Summary step of deploy-landing.yml; both commits pushed successfully to remote.

repo: cipher-box uses actionlint and zizmor for GitHub Actions workflow linting as part of CI checks
deploy-landing.yml had pre-existing actionlint warnings in the Summary step: SC2086 (unquoted $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) and SC2129 (individual redirects instead of grouped)

code.finding: Summary step had SC2086 (unquoted $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) and SC2129 (separate >> redirects) warnings; fixed by quoting the variable and consolidating redirects

workflow: Background git push tasks may not complete before the next action; always verify push status before assuming the remote branch exists
actionlint and zizmor are run together as a pair to validate GitHub Actions workflows

friction: Background commit/push did not complete synchronously, requiring a status check before proceeding
